notes.title: Spring update.
notes.content:
We're glad to announce that now all the characters of the Steam version of Alien Shooter 2 - Reloaded can talk in Russian. 

We hope that everyone who already has this game or prefers English will take this as an appeal to save the humanity once again. 

All the others must take arms and rush into the fight with aliens!
